desc:
👶 GET ADOPTED! 👪

🎀 Get your Sunday-best makeover
🥞 Eat Big Bertha's breakfast (and find the GOLDEN pancake!)
📝 Pass Ms. Hattie's Manners Test
🧸 Play in the playroom until your name is called...

Then the curtain drops on YOUR new family! 🎉
👽 Aliens? 🏴‍☠️ Pirates? 🧛 Vampires? 🦖 DINOSAURS?!
Collect all 16 families and hunt down the secret ones 🤫

🚀 Ride home to their world: space, the sea, the sky and more
💖 Your family follows you everywhere
📖 Fill your Album with special moments
👪 Visit as a PARENT and adopt other players!

Who will YOU get? 💌
